propositions: The retired trigger word 'recheck-review' is a substring of the external CI ChatOps matcher 'recheck' in gerrit_to_platform.ini, causing comments containing the old word to spuriously dispatch the Verified workflow and cancel in-flight CI runs.
The bot's own reply texts embedded the retired trigger word verbatim, making every reply itself a source of spurious CI dispatch.
Rename the trigger token to 'rerun-llm-review', which shares no substring with any mapped comment-added key, and retire the old word with a clear refusal reply.
All bot-posted reply texts must be scrubbed of any ini-mapped trigger words, including the refusal for retired-word comments.
The retired-word refusal must be posted only after the project guard and change re-anchoring to ensure it never replies on out-of-project changes and has valid change_id/revision.
Contributor-facing documentation and code comments must be fully migrated to the new trigger word, leaving the retired word only in the retrigger.py detector and its test module.
